$\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=$
{{field-1}}" :question/worked-solution "The derivative of the natural logarithm is the reciprocal function:

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(ln⁡x)=\frac{1}{x}
$$

We apply our formula and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-\frac{12}{7}ln⁡x) \\  & =-\frac{12}{7}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(ln⁡x) \\  & =-\frac{12}{7}\cdot \frac{1}{x} \\  & =-\frac{12}{7x}.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["d4026733-e07a-5d7b-af8c-4ddcdd5e7562"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "f40367dc-e4a3-50ce-abc9-8a12118b2790" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186096613.py"} [:db/add 17592186096613 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186096613 :knowledge-point/questions ["2aa37d05-2721-560e-879d-45257a2942c1"]} [:db/ensure 17592186096613 :knowledge-point/validate]]
